title: Urenco
summary: British-Dutch-German enrichment consortium supplying reactor fuel.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Urenco provides uranium enrichment services from plants in the UK, Netherlands and Germany, and is expanding capacity as Western utilities diversify away from Russian supply. It also produces medical isotopes. Ownership is split among governments and utilities.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium enrichment
  • Fuel-cycle services
  • Medical isotopes

What To Watch

  • Enrichment capacity additions
  • Utility contract demand
  • Energy costs

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
